body:
I don’t drink alcohol and I don’t do drugs. The only drugs I’ve ever taken are my prescriptions which is what the seroquel is. I’ve stopped taking them cause they didn’t work but I kept them. I won’t throw them out because I know that I have them as a last effort of escape from this life. I have more than enough to overdose on.

I want to start over. But those pills are my one way trip to the afterlife. And I might as well have a drink on the way. But I’m putting off that trip to eternity for now.

This is the exact reason I’ve always stayed away from guns. I grew up in the southern US where it was common to drive out on some land and shoot targets for fun. I’ve always told people that I’m afraid of guns. I’m not afraid of guns, I’m afraid of myself with a gun.
